title: Light Crumbly Brazilian Cheese Frittata
description: A mustardy and crumbly Brazilian dish perfect for brunch, featuring dried oregano and low-fat ingredients, this frittata is a delicious and satisfying meal option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, dried oregano, salt, black pepper, and dijon mustard until well combined.
In a small bowl, mix together the brazilian cheese and whole wheat flour.
Add the cheese mixture to the egg mixture and stir until just combined.
Heat the olive oil in a 9-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes or until the frittata is golden brown and set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Slice the frittata into wedges and serve hot.
